sourceRefs.symbol: planGrow15 body interval and hard classification

findings.mechanism: When cap200 truncates the upper interval, the existing uncalibrated uniform-interval chance can drop below .45 even while o.r itself is at or above the lethal threshold. Soft hazards contribute weighted risk but are excluded from clearance and hard-safe path filtering. Raising an already nominally lethal body to hard therefore restores an existing semantic safety condition without tuning score coefficients.

example.visibleCueConsistency: At true player radius182 and NPC200, the minimap is white and no danger text is drawn. HUD180/181 require a missed danger-label detection for isRed=false, and pure tests label this explicitly.

findings.liveExposureNote: screen-05-01 died at HUD182. Its last saved uncertainNpc sequence was 0,1,1,1,4 at elapsed105..109. This proves soft-hazard exposure, not that a radius200 body or this defect caused death.
findings.scope: The cap-driven nominal200 example affects HUD180..185; immunity at186 remains unchanged. Other pre186 deaths and bad size estimates are not solved by this one fix.

findings.status: source-mechanics limitation proved; not changed in Grow18
findings.mechanism: After geometry rejection, fallback highlightRadius/visualR is used with a 7/10/15 percent error and max(upper, visualR*.88). NPC outline wobble scales the body by .8..1.15 independently of physical radius. These heuristic values do not guarantee a physical upper radius.
findings.conditionalOutlineDerivation: For a complete continuous polygon, x-axis vertices i=0 and i=8 both use 1.01*wobble and their odd-harmonic noise cancels. Their x separation is 2*1.01*wobble*R; full bbox half-extent V>=.808R at wobble>=.8. Thus R<=V/.808 only when V bounds the complete contour. Stroke only increases the ideal bbox.
findings.unconditionalLimitation: components measures a connected hue region, not a certified complete silhouette. Clipped=false excludes screen/UI clipping, not occlusion or hue fragmentation. Neither labelSeen nor compact aspect/density certifies completeness. A finite pixel margin such as +6 is an uncertainty policy, not a proved upper bound for missing contours.

conditionalStrokeExample.assumptions: Analytic continuous source polygon with 9px default miter stroke, no raster, occlusion or saved-image replay.

findings.status: descriptive association only; no complete decision replay
findings.mechanism: Several late cutoff samples selected geometry-rejected/unreliable body targets and assigned path rewards without visible subsequent growth. A path is a proposed 2.2s two-segment rollout, not a committed future action; repeated path gain must not be described as a guaranteed growth forecast. Scouts have zero path-growth contribution; their utility uses an assumed target size only for approach.
findings.limits: No target x/y, persistent ID, blocked/stalled status, full object list, velocity, map or complete per-decision plan input is saved in final samples. Thus no target identity, cause, counterfactual selected direction or full replay is reconstructed.
findings.existingStallMemory: readImage stalled increments only on matching current close NPC while prior.radius===HUD, otherwise resets; no persistent blocked cooldown. This is a separate candidate, not folded into Grow18.

priorityEvidence.interpretation: The concentration before186 supports prioritizing safety-model correctness. A positive saved clearance is not evidence of actual safety, and the last saved decision is not necessarily the lethal frame.

lateWindowDefinition: Saved samples with186<=HUD<200, no interpolation. 1Hz sampling and shared-run dependence; counts are descriptive, not independent-trial estimates.
